label: architect • order total code
query: Build a workflow whose input is a list of order line items (each with qty and price) and that computes the order total and item count with a code step. No model needed. Test it with two items, then offer to save it.
notes: Code-only workflow. Pins that the Architect uses a code node rather than an inference node for deterministic arithmetic and that the test run completes in osaurus-js-host.
